payload.tension: The passage states correction changes with age and kinship. Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers; the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
